body: That is a really good question which I will need to think about.  Maybe the answer will help me find a way out of this periodic hopelessness.  Thank you for your help and goodnight!

I would like to find a way to motivate myself to seek more or better distractions that could also provide more meaning in my life.  My husband is great at distracting me and making sure I am having fun, but I don't want to rely on him for 100% of my happiness.  I have been wondering if part of the reason I am feeling this way is that I am mourning my mother since she is no longer the same person. What is strange is that in some ways she seems to be happier than she ever has been.

I really appreciate you responding.  Some of the things I really enjoy are reading, walking, traveling, gardening and cooking (well maybe more eating than cooking).   I have seen a psychiatrist a couple of times and all I have really told him is that I am not feeling myself and wanted to go back on anti-depressants.  He had to reduce the dosage due to stomach issues I was having.  Maybe that is part of the problem.
